Create Customer.description: Creates a customer, e.g. a beneficiary organisation or partner.

Create Material Request.description: Raises a material request when a facility reports low stock.

Create Stock Entry.description: Records a stock transfer between warehouses, e.g. central store to clinic.

Create Item.description: Adds an item (e.g. a medicine or commodity) to the item master.

Update Document.description: Updates fields on an existing document by name.

Read Document.description: Fetches a single document by name.

List Documents with Filters.description: Lists documents of a doctype, selecting fields and filtering.

Count Documents.description: Counts documents matching filters, e.g. for a dashboard.
